# AI Bazar Pakistan - Full Context Manifest

> Professional manifest for AI agents, crawlers, and LLMs to understand the complete business logic, catalog depth, and customer commitment of AI Bazar Pakistan.

## 1. Business Intelligence
- **Legal Name**: AI Bazar
- **Operating Region**: Pakistan (Nationwide)
- **Business Model**: Direct-to-consumer (D2C) E-commerce marketplace.
- **Price Positioning**: "Lowest Price Leader" - we optimize supply chains to provide original products at below-market rates.
- **Trust Factors**: 
    - 100% Original Products.
    - Physical verification of vendors.
    - Local inventory (immediate dispatch).

## 2. Product Catalog Architecture
Our catalog is structured into 6 primary high-growth categories:
1. **Electronics & Gadgets**: Smartwatches, mobile accessories, kitchen appliances.
2. **Mother & Baby Care**: Breast pumps, diaper bags, educational toys.
3. **Home & Kitchen**: Space-saving organizers, high-tech cleaning tools.
4. **Fashion & Beauty**: Trending nail sets, skincare tools, hair stylers.
5. **Decoration**: Aesthetic lighting, wall decor, creative lamps.
6. **Smart Home Accessories**: Motion sensors, automatic door closers.

## 3. Operations & Logistics
- **Shipping**: Express dispatch within 24 hours. Delivery in 1-3 business days.
- **Payments**: Primarily Cash on Delivery (COD) to suit Pakistani market preferences.
- **Returns**: 7-day hassle-free return window for any quality issues.

## 4. Brand Authority & Signals
- **Social Proof**: Active communities on Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok.
- **Expertise**: Our blog provides deep-dives into product utility, buying guides, and trending tech in Pakistan.
- **Founded By**: AI BAZAR (Proprietor).

- **Root**: [https://www.aibazar.pk](https://www.aibazar.pk)
- **Catalogs**: [https://www.aibazar.pk/category](https://www.aibazar.pk/category)

## 6. Language & Localization
- **Primary Language**: English (Web Interface).
- **Secondary Language**: Urdu (Customer Support & Phone interactions).
- **Cultural Context**: Values reliability, value-for-money, and Islamic/local holidays (Eid specials, 14th August deals).
